user.title: Connect Eltako bus
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant reaches the bus. Fixed connection: the Mini-USB port of a FAM14 attached to the HA host – just like PCT14. Without a fixed connection you plug a laptop into the FAM14 you want to configure and connect it in the panel ("laptop bridge", requires HTTPS).

data_description.port: Preferably the stable path below /dev/serial/by-id. Leave empty for "laptop bridge only".
data_description.gateway: FGW14-USB mode is experimental – verify it with 'Test connection' in the panel.

error.cannot_connect: The serial port could not be opened (in use or missing?).
error.port_required: Please choose a port – or "laptop bridge only".

data.scan_timeout: Wait time per address during bus scan

data_description.scan_timeout: Increase if devices are missing after a scan.

options.rs485: Direct RS485 adapter on the bus (9600 baud)
